decisions.reason: The PETG thermoforming blank remains tightly aligned with the firm's established dental materials know-how, production systems, and laboratory customer base, so management would keep it and exploit accumulated learning rather than withdraw it.
The intraoral contrast spray fits the firm's move toward digital dental workflows and benefits from related application and channel knowledge, making continued refinement more attractive than exit.

The custom earmold line builds directly on the firm's deep hearing-care custom manufacturing capabilities and specialist distribution relationships, giving it very strong absorptive capacity and a low likelihood of withdrawal.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are still a close extension of the firm's earmold expertise and channels, so they are likely to be retained, though their somewhat more adjacent use case leaves slightly more uncertainty than the core earmold line.
